profile_text.body:
Replit is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a platform for building and deploying software collaboratively using AI, with a stated emphasis on eliminating setup time for developers and teams.

Replit's primary AI product is Replit Agent, categorized as an agentic coding tool. The company also offers a feature it calls Intelligent Model Routing, which it describes as delivering the same quality output at 65% lower average cost than the previous version of its Max Mode. The site notes a source-code exposure concern associated with Replit Agent.

The held facts show 174 law-related data points associated with California, and Replit has a registered MCP server entry described as providing free buyer-side outcome verification and provider comparison for supplied agent receipts.
